features:
Key Features:

Low-Fat & Cholesterol-Free: Specially formulated to support heart health by reducing saturated fats and eliminating cholesterol.

Calcium & Iron Enriched: Each serving provides a meaningful amount of calcium and iron, essential for bone health and energy production.

Versatile Baking Mix: Perfect for making pancakes, waffles, biscuits, and other baked favorites—all from one convenient mix.

Simple Ingredients: Made with enriched flour, plant-based oils, leavening agents, and just a touch of sugar.

Quick & Easy to Use: Requires only a few additional ingredients like water, milk, or eggs, depending on the recipe.

Benefits:

Heart-Healthy Option: Designed for people looking to manage cholesterol and saturated fat intake without sacrificing taste.

Time-Saving Convenience: Ideal for busy mornings or quick baking needs, with reliable results every time.

Customizable: Can be mixed with fruits, spices, or nuts to boost flavor and nutritional value.

Trusted Brand: Produced by Betty Crocker, a household name known for quality and consistency.

Great for Families: Suitable for a variety of dietary needs and easy enough for kids and beginners to use.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (canola, high oleic soybean, and/or sunflower oil), Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Sugar, Dextrose, Tricalcium Phosphate, Salt.
